target_customer: Restaurant brands selling through third party delivery marketplaces
problem: Restaurants lose money to disputed orders, payout mismatches, bad promotion ROI and store downtime on delivery marketplaces.

founders.name: Priyam Saraswat
founders.background_notes: YC page calls him a second time entrepreneur.

technical_complexity.rationale: Data integration with delivery marketplaces and analytics dashboards; later AI automation.

defensibility.rationale: Dependent on marketplace data access and easy to copy by POS vendors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Marketplace partner dashboards stayed limited per a secondary source; no copying by incumbents documented.

market_need_then: Restaurants in India were shifting to Zomato and Swiggy delivery in 2020, creating need for sales visibility and margin tracking.

rebrands.from: Voosh restaurant analytics and virtual chain
rebrands.why: Productized internal solution as an AI platform per Dealroom

branding.community_and_virality: No merch or community evidence found; name resembles several unrelated companies.

brand_strength.rationale: Short invented name with no evidence of brand driven growth.

pivots.from: Virtual restaurant chain on decentralized kitchens
pivots.why: Productized the internal tooling; Voosh.ai launched early 2023 per Dealroom.

outcome_analysis: Voosh began as an Indian virtual restaurant chain with a December 2020 pre-seed from Better Capital, then turned its internal data tooling into software and moved to the US market, with customers such as a Wendy's franchisee and KFC franchise group. No later round, exit or shutdown was found, so it looks like a quiet, active company.
notes: Pre-seed reported by two outlets, amount undisclosed. Databases list a seed (2021) and $130K total; unverified. Search snippets name Lilit Ohanyan as a third co-founder but the YC page does not, so not listed. No dated competitor source from 2020 to 2021 found; competitor list left empty. Priyam education not confirmed by an opened source.
